title_text: WHEN THE EARTH GIVES UP THE DEAD
credits_text: Starring Yong Coultas, Alisa Russell, Dave Martin. Produced by James R. Winterbottom & Matthew Paulding. Written & Directed by Matthew Gosper. A Worldwide Pandemonium Production.
